description: Black-Scholes model computation (no live quotes): either a generated option chain for an expiry, or multi-leg payoff analysis (max loss/profit, breakevens, net premium) with per-leg Greeks. Model values from inputs, not a recommendation. Paid via x402 ($0.02 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

expiryDate.description: Chain expiry, YYYY-MM-DD (chain mode; or use expiryDays)

legs.description: Legs mode: 1–8 option legs to analyse as one strategy

strikes.description: Chain strikes (default: 9 strikes around the underlying)

name: options_greeks
